svg.text: At-least-once fan-out · HMAC-signed · retried with jittered backoff · dead deliveries are replayable
Every delivery leaves through the guard.
It is the one place Relay opens a connection
to a URL a customer controls.
A dead delivery is the DLQ —
a row state, not a table.
event row + outbox row, one transaction
claim due outbox rows, then write delivery rows
XADD one message per subscribed endpoint
HMAC-sign, then resolve and vet the host
connect to the pinned IP; 2xx = delivered
pop the retries whose time has come
re-XADD: retries take the first-attempt path
XAUTOCLAIM work orphaned by a dead dispatcher
SSE live timeline to the console
